name: Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: spaghetti, ground beef, tomato sauce, onion, garlic, olive oil
instructions: Cook pasta. Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add tomato sauce. Combine with pasta.

name: Chicken Curry
ingredients: chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, curry powder, coconut milk
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger. Add chicken and curry powder. Stir in coconut milk and simmer.

name: Pancakes
ingredients: flour, milk, eggs, sugar, baking powder, butter
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Add milk and eggs. Cook on griddle with butter until golden.

name: Greek Salad
ingredients: tomato, cucumber, feta cheese, olives, onion, olive oil, oregano
instructions: Chop vegetables. Toss with olive oil and oregano. Add feta and olives.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread, add cheese, and grill until golden and melted.
